description: Registry of cinema business flows. Lets a regression check map a code diff back to the business workflows it may impact (not just files, but behavior). Each flow: trigger_keywords detected in a diff → flow surfaced with invariants at risk + concrete regression symptoms.
match_strategy: ANY keyword in trigger_keywords matches diff text (case-insensitive). If several flows match, all are surfaced.

flows.name: Seat locking + booking → invoice lifecycle
invariants_at_risk: Seat lock store is a process-local static ConcurrentDictionary keyed {showTimeId}:{roomId}:{seatId}
CreateBookingAsync creates Invoice Status=Pending inside a transaction
Status logic uses InvoiceStatus/SeatStatus enums, never magic numbers
regression_symptoms: Lock store made non-static/instance → locks not shared, two clients book the same seat
5-min expiry removed → abandoned seat held forever
Unlock not owner-scoped → client B releases client A's held seat
Booking created as Paid or without a transaction → free tickets / orphan InvoiceTicket rows
Paid invoice becomes cancellable, or a user cancels someone else's booking
Status compared as integer literal → silent corruption when enum renumbered

flows.name: Authentication — login, register, JWT, role gating
invariants_at_risk: JWT carries the Role claim that drives [Authorize(Roles="Admin")]
Admin endpoints gated by the Admin role
FE stores JWT under localStorage key 'cinema_token'
regression_symptoms: Login returns a token for a wrong password → account takeover
Role claim dropped or admin gate removed → privilege escalation
JWT key renamed without updating the interceptor → everyone logged out

flows.name: Admin movie & catalog management — CRUD, role gating, soft delete
invariants_at_risk: Write endpoints (Create/Update/Delete movie + catalog) stay Admin-only
DeleteAsync is a soft delete (IsActive=false), not a hard row delete
Admin FE routes are behind adminGuard
regression_symptoms: Admin write endpoint loses its role gate → any logged-in user edits the catalog
DeleteAsync becomes a hard delete → loss of history / FK breakage
List contract drifts → admin grids break
Admin FE routes lose adminGuard → back-office reachable by anyone logged in
